business_rules: Only execution.blocking=true sensors may be started this way.
On success, registry entry includes held_by:[{kind:manual, attached_at:…}] and signals_log_path.
behavior.summary: Phase 0: validate sensor and confirm blocking. Phase 1: resolve+run dep graph (none here). Phase 2: prepare[] of root. Phase 3: spawn `sh -c <command>` detached (Setsid, stdout/stderr → raw.log) and spawn the watcher binary tailing raw.log into signals.log. Phase 4: write registry entry. Phase 5: emit started Signal.

description: Happy path: invoke /start-sensor on a sensor declaring execution.blocking=true that has no live registry entry and no requires[kind=sensor]. The script validates the JSON, runs prepare[] steps, fork+execs the command detached, spawns a watcher to tail raw.log into signals.log, writes the registry entry with held_by:[{kind:manual}], and emits a started Signal verdict=pass metadata.kind=started.

evidence.rationale: runStart performs the lifecycle including registry write and started Signal emission.
Watcher process tails raw.log and parses lines into signals.log.

invariants: Subprocess is alive and detached (kill(pid,0) succeeds).
Registry entry exists with held_by containing kind=manual.
expected_outcome.shape: JSONL on stdout + filesystem side effects
expected_outcome.summary: Stdout has one started Signal; the registry file gains a dev-server entry; raw.log + signals.log exist under .harness/runtime/dev-server/.

name: Start a blocking sensor with no deps and no live entry

preconditions: No entry for dev-server in running_sensors.json
trigger.summary: Agent invokes the start-sensor script with a single bare sensor id.
